svg.title: The publication protocol
svg.desc: A sequence diagram across four actors — the upstream provider, the forecast job, the static dataset, and the reader's browser. The build phase resolves and fetches one run; the publish phase uploads history, site documents, the manifest as the commit point, and runs.json in that order, with a read-back check; the read phase shows the browser fetching manifest and profile in a retry loop that treats a disagreeing pair as stale.
